newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cinema Plus to raise A$31 mln, list on ASX.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cinema Plus to raise A$31 mln, list on ASX.

text.p: Australia's Cinema Plus Ltd said on Thursday it would list on the Australian Stock Exchange with the issue of 31 million shares at an issue price of A$1.00 per share.
The company, which operates giant cinema screens, said the issue would be underwritten by Prudential-Bache Securities with the offer opening on September 12 and closing on September 22.
Chairman Keith Moremon said the company would have a total of 75 million shares on issue with existing shareholders holding 44 million shares or 58.7 percent of the issued capital.
The other shareholders included a unit of Macquarie Bank and a company associated with executive vice-chairman Gary Blom.
Cinemas Plus has the exclusive contract for the development of large format IMAX cinemas in Australia and New Zealand.
The first cinema will open in Sydney at the Darling Harbour complex on September 26.
The company forecast 1996/97 net profit of A$2.7 million on sales of A$13.6 million, representing nine months of trading from the Sydney cinema.
The net profit is forecast to rise to A$6.4 million on sales of A$27.3 million in 1997/98, which will include an eight month contribution from a cinema in Melbourne due to open in spring 1997.
The company forecast total fully franked dividends of 2.6 cents per share in 1996/97, rising to 5.9 cents a share in 1997/98.
